name: tabvault
description: TabVault - High-performance browser tab stash with cross-PC synchronization and cloud backup

scripts.package:chrome: powershell -Command "if (!(Test-Path releases)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path releases }; tar -a -c -f releases/tabvault-chrome-v2.0.0.zip manifest.json background.js popup.html popup.css popup.js dashboard.html dashboard.css dashboard.js lib icons"
scripts.package:firefox: powershell -Command "if (!(Test-Path releases)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path releases }; tar -a -c -f releases/tabvault-firefox-v2.0.0.zip manifest.json background.js popup.html popup.css popup.js dashboard.html dashboard.css dashboard.js lib icons"
scripts.package:all: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
